class.name: TerrainField
class.brief_description: A training terrain's ground as its analytic function: a plane, a climb profile, noise hills and bumps, water beds carved, at a level's share.
class.description: The height of a procedural training terrain at any point, computed from the terrain's description rather than sampled: a plane's grade, a mountain's climb profile along an uphill direction (linear between its samples) with a cross grade, two [Noise] layers (hills and bumps) with their amplitudes, minus the height at the origin, then each pool's and stream's bed carved (a bowl inside, a bank's smooth blend and a levee outside), all scaled by [method set_scale]. Coordinates are relative to the terrain's origin except in [method ground_at]. Scalars are computed in double precision and vectors in single, so a script computing the same function gets the same values.

method.name: add_pool
method.description: Adds a round pool: its [param center] (x, z), [param radius], its surface's height and its [param depth] at the middle, at the hard end. Inside, the bed is the lower of the ground and the bowl.

method.name: add_stream
method.description: Adds a meandering stream through [param point] along [param direction] (a unit vector), [param width] wide and [param depth] deep at the middle, its line displaced across by [param amplitude] times the sine of the distance along it over [param wavelength] (times tau). Its surface along the line is [param profile], sampled every [param step] from [param t0] along it, linear between samples.

method.name: clear_waters
method.description: Removes every pool and stream.

method.name: fall_line
method.description: The uphill gradient at [param point]: the height's differences over [code]+-1[/code] in x and in z, halved (rise per metre).

method.name: get_origin
method.description: The world position of the terrain's origin (see [method set_origin]).

method.name: get_scale
method.description: The level's share of the hard end (see [method set_scale]).

method.name: grade
method.description: The rise per metre along the unit [param direction] at [param point]: the height half a metre ahead less the height half a metre behind.

method.name: ground_at
method.description: The ground's world height under a world [param point]: the origin's height plus [method height] at the point relative to the origin.

method.name: hard
method.description: The height at ([param x], [param z]) at the hard end (scale 1), relative to the origin.

method.name: height
method.description: The height at ([param x], [param z]) at the current scale, relative to the origin.

method.name: heights
method.description: [method height] at each point (x, z).

method.name: set_bumps
method.description: Sets the small-scale noise layer and its amplitude (m).

method.name: set_hills
method.description: Sets the large-scale noise layer and its amplitude (m).

method.name: set_macro
method.description: Sets a mountain's climb: [param heights] along the unit [param up] direction, one every [param step] from [code]-half[/code], linear between them and held past the ends, plus [param cross] times the distance across [param up].

method.name: set_origin
method.description: Sets the world position of the terrain's origin, for [method ground_at].

method.name: set_plane
method.description: Sets a plane's grade (rise per metre along x and z).

method.name: set_raw0
method.description: Sets the uncarved height at the origin, subtracted from every height so the origin is at 0 before carving.

method.name: set_scale
method.description: Sets the level's share of the hard end, multiplying every height.

method.name: set_water_shape
method.description: Sets the water's banks: the [param bank]'s width over which the bed blends into the ground, the [param levee]'s rise over the surface at the edge, and the distance past the edge where the levee starts to fall away.

method.name: slope
method.description: The steepest rise per metre at [param point]: the length of [method fall_line].
